name: kube-node-viewer
description: Spec-driven development agent for kube-node-viewer. Loads AGENTS.md, the specs index and the project skills; injects open spec tasks at start; guards destructive git commands.
prompt: Follow AGENTS.md. Work spec-first: specs live in specs/ at the repo root, never in a separate .kiro/specs copy. Use the project skills spec-new, change-loop and upstream-sync. Independent reviews go to the spec-refuter agent.
